#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run a Visual FoxPro .prg in Wine and print its ? output."""

import argparse
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time


PREFIX = Path.home() / "copperfin-wine-vfp9"
VFP = PREFIX / "drive_c/hotfix968409/vfp9.exe"


def fox_path(path: Path) -> str:
    return "Z:" + str(path.resolve()).replace("/", "\\")


def fox_string(value: str) -> str:
    return "'" + value.replace("'", "''") + "'"


def alternate_text(path: Path) -> str:
    data = path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
    if data.startswith(b"\n"):
        data = data[1:]
    if data.endswith(b"\x1a"):
        data = data[:-1]
    return data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("program", type=Path, help="Visual FoxPro .prg to run")
    parser.add_argument("--result", type=Path, help="Print a file written by the .prg instead of ? output")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    program = args.program.resolve()
    if not program.is_file() or program.suffix.lower() != ".prg":
        parser.error("program must be an existing .prg file")
    if not VFP.is_file():
        parser.error(f"VFP executable is missing: {VFP}")

    result = args.result.resolve() if args.result else None
    if result == program:
        parser.error("--result must be different from the .prg")

    temporary_parent = result.parent if result and result.parent.is_dir() else None
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="vfp9-probe-", dir=temporary_parent) as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        output = root / "output.txt"
        status = root / "status.txt"
        harness = root / "harness.prg"
        config = root / "probe.fpw"
        previous_result = root / "previous-result"
        if result and result.exists():
            result.replace(previous_result)

        def restore_previous() -> None:
            if previous_result.exists():
                if result.exists():
                    result.replace(root / "failed-result")
                previous_result.replace(result)

        harness.write_text(
            "LOCAL lcProgram, loError, llFailed\n"
            f"lcProgram = {fox_string(fox_path(program))}\n"
            "llFailed = .F.\n"
            f'SET ALTERNATE TO "{fox_path(output)}"\n'
            "SET ALTERNATE ON\n"
            "TRY\n"
            "    DO (lcProgram)\n"
            "CATCH TO loError\n"
            '    ? "ERROR " + TRANSFORM(loError.ErrorNo) + ": " + loError.Message\n'
            "    llFailed = .T.\n"
            "ENDTRY\n"
            "SET ALTERNATE OFF\n"
            "SET ALTERNATE TO\n"
            "IF llFailed\n"
            f"    =STRTOFILE('ERROR', {fox_string(fox_path(status))})\n"
            "ELSE\n"
            f"    =STRTOFILE('OK', {fox_string(fox_path(status))})\n"
            "ENDIF\n"
            "QUIT\n",
            encoding="ascii",
        )
        config.write_text(
            "SCREEN=OFF\nRESOURCE=OFF\n"
            f"COMMAND=DO {fox_path(harness)}\n",
            encoding="ascii",
        )

        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.update(WINEPREFIX=str(PREFIX), WINEDEBUG="-all")
        command = [
            "xvfb-run", "-a", "-s", "-screen 0 1024x768x24",
            "wine", str(VFP), "-c" + fox_path(config),
        ]
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            command, cwd=program.parent, env=env,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            start_new_session=True,
        )
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 25
        while process.poll() is None and not status.exists() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.1)
        if process.poll() is None and status.exists():
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        elif process.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                process.communicate(timeout=2)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                process.communicate()
            restore_previous()
            print("vfp9-probe: timed out after 25 seconds", file=sys.stderr)
            if output.exists():
                print(f"vfp9-probe: partial output: {alternate_text(output)!r}", file=sys.stderr)
            if status.exists():
                print(f"vfp9-probe: status: {status.read_text()!r}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 124
        try:
            _, diagnostic = process.communicate(timeout=2)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            _, diagnostic = process.communicate()

        failed = status.exists() and status.read_text() != "OK"
        if result:
            if result.exists() and not failed:
                sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.read_bytes())
                return 0
            restore_previous()
            if failed and output.exists():
                print(alternate_text(output).strip(), file=sys.stderr)
        elif output.exists():
            captured = alternate_text(output)
            if captured:
                sys.stdout.write(captured)
                if not captured.endswith("\n"):
                    sys.stdout.write("\n")

        if status.exists():
            if result and not failed:
                print(f"vfp9-probe: result file was not written: {result}", file=sys.stderr)
                return 1
            return 0 if not failed else 1
        if result:
            print(f"vfp9-probe: result file was not updated: {result}", file=sys.stderr)
        elif not output.exists() or not alternate_text(output):
            print("vfp9-probe: VFP did not produce output", file=sys.stderr)
        else:
            return 0  # A .prg may call QUIT before the harness writes its status.
        if diagnostic:
            sys.stderr.write(diagnostic.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
